hints.content:
The *scale factor* in a dilation changes every length in the figure and changes the distance of each point from the center of dilation.

$\dfrac{\text{length of image}}{\text{length of source}}=\text{scale factor}$

Segment $\overline{A'B'}$ has a length of $6$ units.

options.alt: A first quadrant coordinate plane. The image and pre-image of pentagons are graphed. The pre-image pentagon has vertices A at eight, zero, B at twelve, zero, C at twelve, two, D at ten, four, and E at eight, two. The image pentagon has vertices A prime at zero, five, B prime at six, eight, C prime at six, eight, D prime at three, eleven, and E prime at zero, eight.
